description: Jet 4 MDB: qkrw DAO Database.Execute (ANSI-89) vs DEFAULT DDL discriminator: tests CREATE TABLE with DEFAULT (Long, Text, DateTime, NOT NULL DEFAULT), ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT, and ALTER TABLE ALTER COLUMN SET DEFAULT / DROP DEFAULT via DAO Execute(dbFailOnError). Captures exact DAO error numbers (3290/3293) and keeps all pages before/after to verify file-byte impact.
